test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 

I felt hungry around midnight but there was _______ anything in the fridge.
solution:
TB Solution:

The correct answer is** 'hardly.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• hardly means **almost no; almost not; almost none.**

​ -Example: Snow **hardly** ever falls near the coast.

 
• So it is clear that the most appropriate word is 'hardly'.
 
• The complete sentence is "**I felt hungry around midnight but there was hardly anything in the fridge**".

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Ample** means enough or more than enough.
 
• **Only** means with no others existing or present.
 
• **Somewhat** means rather; to some degree.
